profile.name: DL3000系列直流电子负载
profile.description: 这是一款台式可编程直流电子负载，用于吸收被测电源提供的电流，并在恒流、恒压等模式下评估电源、适配器、电池和电源转换器的输出性能。设备支持电压、电流测量，以及远端感测和前面板锁定等实验室常用功能。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop programmable DC electronic load used to sink current from a device under test and evaluate the output performance of power supplies, adapters, batteries, and power converters in modes such as constant current and constant voltage. It supports voltage and current measurement, along with common lab features such as remote sensing and front-panel lock.

registry.name: RIGOL DL3000 Programmable DC Electronic Load
registry.description: RIGOL DL3000 Programmable DC Electronic Load是由RIGOL Technologies生产的电池测试柜，主要功能包括初始化、测量、电流设置。
